policy: V20 registers MetaPay one-time distribution execution evidence and Financial OS owner-distribution accounting. Only actually SETTLED beneficiary legs may reduce cash/equity. Owner distributions are signed EXTERNAL_CAPITAL outflows and are excluded from realized P&L.

additions.authority_note: MetaPay one-time exact-batch attempt. DistributionAuthorization is consumed when this attempt is created, before settlement, to prevent replay after partial success. Attempt has no accounting authority.
Terminal per-beneficiary exact same-currency settlement evidence bound to Plan/Auth/Ticket/Attempt. V1 permits zero payer-borne external fee only; profit recognition is NOT_PERFORMED.

MetaPay terminal batch utilization over exactly one terminal receipt per beneficiary. FULL/PARTIAL/FAILED states all retain authorization_consumption=CONSUMED; partial remainder requires new Plan/Authorization.

Financial OS decision binding raw MetaPay attempt/utilization/receipt evidence to an explicit operational-source -> ReportingLedger cash-account mapping. Only SETTLED total is POSTABLE. Canonical posting is EXTERNAL_CAPITAL owner-distribution outflow and excluded from realized P&L. Decision itself cannot mutate ledger.
